# High School Financial Literacy Curriculum Overview

This curriculum provides a six-week framework designed to equip high school students with essential personal finance knowledge and skills. It covers core topics from budgeting and saving to understanding debt and basic investing, empowering students to make informed financial decisions for their future.

## Curriculum Roadmap: Weeks 1-6

| Phase         | Goal                                    | Key Tasks                                                                | Deliverable                                   |
| :------------ | :-------------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------- | :-------------------------------------------- |
| **Week 1: Foundations** | Understand importance; Set goals        | Define financial literacy; Discuss personal financial goals; Introduce income vs. expenses | Personal financial goal statement             |
| **Week 2: Budgeting**   | Create & maintain a personal budget     | Identify income sources; Categorize expenses; Apply 50/30/20 rule; Track spending | Personalized monthly budget plan              |
| **Week 3: Saving**      | Learn saving principles & strategies    | Differentiate short/long-term savings; Understand emergency funds; Explore savings accounts; Discuss compound interest | Savings plan for a specific goal              |
| **Week 4: Debt & Credit** | Comprehend debt types; Responsible credit use | Define good vs. bad debt; Explain credit scores/reports; Discuss credit cards & loans; Avoid predatory lending | Credit awareness quiz; Credit pros/cons analysis |
| **Week 5: Investing Basics** | Understand investment concepts & options | Explain inflation & risk/reward; Introduce stocks, bonds, mutual funds; Discuss diversification; Explore retirement accounts | Basic investment portfolio concept            |
| **Week 6: Future Planning** | Integrate concepts into a holistic plan | Review insurance types (health, auto); Discuss tax basics; Plan for future education/career; Create long-term roadmap | Personal financial action plan                |

## Your Home Comfort, Simplified: Smart Thermostat User Manual

This guide will help you quickly set up and operate your new smart thermostat, ensuring optimal comfort and energy efficiency in your home.

### Setting Temperature Schedules
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg
Personalize your climate control by setting specific temperatures for different times of the day or week.

- **Access Schedule Menu:** From the home screen, tap the "Schedule" icon or navigate to "Settings" > "Scheduling."
- **Choose Day/Period:** Select a day (e.g., "Monday") or a predefined period (e.g., "Weekday," "Weekend").
- **Add/Edit Events:** Tap "+" or select an existing time slot to set a desired temperature.
- **Set Time and Temperature:** Adjust the start time and the target temperature for each event (e.g., 7:00 AM, 72°F).
- **Save Changes:** Confirm your settings to apply the schedule. Your thermostat will now automatically adjust.

### Optimizing with Eco-Mode
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
Eco-Mode helps conserve energy by automatically adjusting temperature settings when you're away or during off-peak hours, based on your preferences.

- **Enable Eco-Mode:** On the thermostat screen, tap the "Eco" button or find it under "Settings" > "Energy Saving."
- **Customize Settings (Optional):** You can often define the temperature range for Eco-Mode or enable/disable geofencing (using your phone's location to detect when you're away).
- **Deactivate Eco-Mode:** Tap the "Eco" button again or manually adjust the temperature to override it.

### Connecting to Wi-Fi
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/wifi.svg
Connecting your thermostat to Wi-Fi enables remote control via a smartphone app, voice assistant integration, and automatic software updates.

- **Enter Setup Mode:** On the thermostat, go to "Settings" > "Network" or "Wi-Fi Setup."
- **Select Network:** Choose your home Wi-Fi network from the list of available networks.
- **Enter Password:** Use the thermostat's touchscreen or companion app to enter your Wi-Fi password.
- **Confirm Connection:** Once connected, a Wi-Fi icon will appear on the thermostat's home screen, and you'll receive a confirmation message.
- **Download App:** For full remote control, download the official [Your Thermostat Brand] app from your device's app store and follow the in-app instructions to pair your thermostat.

### Quick Actions
- Full User Manual: [Button: Download PDF] https://www.example.com/manuals/smart-thermostat-v1.pdf
- Get Mobile App: [Button: App Store] https://www.example.com/app/download

response_text:
# Mobile Banking App FAQs

Here are some frequently asked questions to help users navigate your new mobile banking application, covering essential topics from initial setup to security.

## Account Setup & Access
- **How do I register for the mobile banking app?**
  - Download the app from your device's app store.
  - Select "Register" or "Sign Up" and follow the on-screen prompts to verify your identity and create your login credentials.
- **What information do I need to register?**
  - You will typically need your bank account number, registered mobile number, and possibly your debit card details or national ID for verification.
- **Can I link multiple bank accounts to the app?**
  - Yes, you can link all eligible accounts associated with your customer ID after initial setup. Navigate to the "Accounts" section to add more.
- **What should I do if I forget my login PIN or password?**
  - On the login screen, tap "Forgot PIN/Password" and follow the secure steps to reset your credentials using registered details.

## Fund Transfers & Payments
- **How do I send money using the app?**
  - Select "Transfer Funds," choose the recipient (from saved beneficiaries or new), enter the amount, and confirm the transaction with your PIN or biometric authentication.
- **What are the daily transfer limits?**
  - Transfer limits vary by account type and security settings. You can view your specific limits in the "Settings" or "Limits" section of the app.
- **How long does it take for a fund transfer to complete?**
  - Most transfers are instant, especially between accounts within the same bank or through real-time payment systems. Transfers to other banks may take a few hours to one business day.
- **Can I schedule future or recurring transfers?**
  - Yes, the app allows you to set up scheduled or recurring payments. Look for the "Schedule Transfer" or "Recurring Payments" option within the transfer section.
- **Is international fund transfer supported?**
  - Yes, international transfers are supported to select countries. Go to "International Transfer" for details on supported currencies, fees, and processing times.

## Security Features & Protection
- **How does the app protect my financial information?**
  - The app uses advanced encryption (SSL/TLS), multi-factor authentication, and secure servers to protect your data. Your data is never stored directly on your device.
- **What is two-factor authentication (2FA)?**
  - 2FA adds an extra layer of security by requiring a second verification step, such as a one-time password (OTP) sent to your registered mobile number, in addition to your password.
- **What should I do if my phone is lost or stolen?**
  - Immediately contact our customer support to temporarily block access to your mobile banking app. You can also remotely deregister your device via our website.
- **How can I report suspicious activity or unauthorized transactions?**
  - Navigate to the "Security" or "Support" section within the app and select "Report Fraud" or contact our dedicated fraud helpline immediately.

## Quick Actions
- Action: [Button: Contact Support] https://www.examplebank.com/support
- Action: [Button: Download App (iOS)] https://apps.apple.com/us/app/examplebank
- Action: [Button: Download App (Android)] https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.examplebank

## Sources
- Example Bank Mobile Banking Terms & Conditions: https://www.examplebank.com/terms
- National Payments Corporation of India (for UPI info): https://www.npci.org.in/
- Financial Conduct Authority (UK banking guidelines): https://www.fca.org.uk/

response_text:
# User Profile Retrieval API Overview
This document specifies the `GET /users/{user_id}` API endpoint, designed to retrieve detailed profile information for a given user. This endpoint provides a standardized way to access user data securely and efficiently.

# Endpoint Details
- **Path**: `/users/{user_id}`
- **Method**: `GET`
- **Description**: Retrieves the profile details for the user identified by `user_id`.

# Request Parameters
- **`user_id`** (Path Parameter)
  - **Type**: Integer
  - **Description**: A unique identifier for the user whose profile is being requested.
  - **Required**: Yes

# Successful Response Format (HTTP 200 OK)
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/person-check.svg
Upon a successful request, the API returns a JSON object containing the user's profile data.

```
{
  "user_id": 12345,
  "username": "johndoe",
  "email": "john.doe@example.com",
  "first_name": "John",
  "last_name": "Doe",
  "registration_date": "2023-01-15T10:30:00Z",
  "last_login": "2024-04-23T14:45:00Z",
  "status": "active"
}
```

# Error Codes
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/exclamation-circle.svg
Potential error responses from the API are detailed below, each returning a JSON object with `code` and `message` fields.

- **HTTP Status: 400 Bad Request**
  - **Code**: `BAD_REQUEST`
  - **Description**: The request was malformed (e.g., invalid `user_id` format).
- **HTTP Status: 401 Unauthorized**
  - **Code**: `UNAUTHORIZED`
  - **Description**: Authentication credentials were missing or invalid.
- **HTTP Status: 403 Forbidden**
  - **Code**: `FORBIDDEN`
  - **Description**: The authenticated user does not have permission to access this profile.
- **HTTP Status: 404 Not Found**
  - **Code**: `NOT_FOUND`
  - **Description**: No user found with the provided `user_id`.
- **HTTP Status: 500 Internal Server Error**
  - **Code**: `SERVER_ERROR`
  - **Description**: An unexpected internal server error occurred on the server.

# Quick Actions
- Action: [Button: View Full API Documentation] https://example.com/api-docs/user-profile
- Action: [Button: Access API Testing Tool] https://example.com/api-tester?endpoint=/users/{user_id}

# Photo Editor v2.1 Update
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/image.svg

We're excited to announce the release of Photo Editor version 2.1, packed with powerful new tools and essential improvements to enhance your editing workflow!

## Key Enhancements & Fixes
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/magic.svg

This update focuses on intelligent editing capabilities and performance optimizations.
